# UI/UX Pro Max — Portable Fallback

Use for comprehensive UI/UX analysis or design direction.

## Analyze

- user task and information hierarchy;
- navigation and flow;
- layout/grid/spacing;
- typography and density;
- color/contrast;
- component/state consistency;
- loading/empty/error/auth states;
- forms and validation;
- tables/charts;
- responsive behavior;
- accessibility/keyboard;
- motion/feedback;
- content clarity.

## Evidence

Inspect the actual rendered interface and relevant code/design system.

When a strong reference/template exists, compare concrete component/page patterns and reuse them rather than merely matching colors.

## Output

Prioritize issues by user impact and systemic reach.

Separate design-system fixes from page-local corrections.

Do not convert the audit into a checklist of generic “best practices” disconnected from the product.
